newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mixed in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mixed in slow trading.

text.p: Spot millfeed prices were mixed on Friday as dealers pointed to scant nearby supplies ahead of the Christmas holiday week.
"I look for extreme tightness," a Missouri dealer said, referring to the downtimes that flour mills will take during the next few weeks.
He said he expected the tightness to carry over into early January.
"There are people who want it but can't find it," a Minneapolis dealer said. "That is all you can say. The market is tight and if you don't own it, you probably won't get it."
But in the Carolinas, activity was subdued.
"This market is dead, there is nothing going on," a dealer there said.
